reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: GET() is a public HTTP API endpoint (no internal caller requirement). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is any authenticated user over HTTP — untrusted. Gate 3: src/app/api/ is explicitly in scope. Code confirmed: route.ts:8-37 applies only a time-window check (JST 22:50–23:50) with zero authentication or role assertion; middleware.ts:38-39 validates only cookie existence, not role. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/admin/force-logout-all (HTTP) by sending the request with any valid session cookies during the 22:50–23:50 JST window, causing forceLogoutAll() to bulk-insert type:'out' attendance records for every currently checked-in user, corrupting all active attendance sessions.
